notes: run-events-claude-live.test.ts was unsealed (custody override r1-g1); its old expectation [prepare, fix] is the r2-6 defect and is replaced. Max fix rounds reaches the claude path from the run policy; ? is accepted only where the reader has no policy (unit level), mirroring cycle-wiring stageLabel. Attempt 2 (repair): the run policy max reaches the claude path through readIterationOutcome's defaulted 5th parameter { maxFixRounds } (arity stays 2, AC7); `?` only with no policy (r2-6-w2). Threading it from spawnIteration/driveRun is the fixer's wiring inside fixScope; no row forces its source on the loop path. Unreadable close status is the token `unknown` (the workflow's own tally token, pair-implement-batch.js tally `r.status ?? 'unknown'`); a readable status is the workflow return `batch[].{id,status}`. Attempt 3 (repair of fix-max-wiring / close-status-source): r2-6-w5 forces spawnIteration to forward maxFixRounds to the reader (stub engine, recorded fixture); r2-6-w6 forces the loop path (handler → driveRun → driveIteration) to hand every iteration an integer max — its source (the run cycle budget, workflow pipeline maxFixRounds) is the fixer's to record in the decision log. r2-7-w5/w6 add the pair-loop return shape (default pair run skill) and the return JSON quoted in prose. run-events-claude-live.test.ts tsc TS2554 (5th arg) is the r2-6-w3 defect itself, red until the fix.
